renderer: deterministic p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D reciprocal attention field
primitiveBudget: one generated Canvas 2D social field, fifteen directional witnesses, four liftable global backcasts, and no imported imagery
commitThreshold: three distinct witnesses must be noticed before look-back can commit
memoryRule: a backcast stores the stale direction of attention and reorients every witness; visited witnesses deepen their notch and all agents change stance, scale, and position; four backcasts persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch moves through situated witnesses; look-back commits; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight focuses; Enter/Space performs deterministic look-back; Delete lifts; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: proof strip, suspended vessel, and pressure slab -> distributed Canvas 2D ecology of directional witnesses
compositionRupture: horizontal register and singular bodies -> two loose offset bands with no privileged centre or container
encounterRupture: correction drag, stillness hold, and dwell-return -> continuous reciprocal noticing followed by look-back
temporalRupture: remote misprint and displaced echo -> global stale-direction memory that changes every situated body
mediumRupture: proof fragments, WebGL shell, and slab cavities -> generated Canvas 2D notched witnesses, live facing, and consensus seams
changedRule: After three distinct witnesses turn toward the visitor, the naive model backcasts the last direction of attention through the entire field; the whole ecology agrees with a stare that has already moved on.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a dark indigo ecology of fifteen abstract directional bodies. A valid look-back changes every witness's orientation, notch, scale, stance, and position and adds a seam of false consensus; four backcasts remain visible and liftable.
falsifier: Delete if proximity only moves a cursor, one or two notices commit, repeated notices count twice, backcast only recolours a fixed image, the field does not change globally, memory resets, lifting is inexact, or the blind ecology reads as a generic flock or dashboard.
deletionCondition: Delete v048 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish reciprocal attention and stale global consensus from v045-v047, or if the look-back rule is not visible without labels and prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
